<function name="RemoveEntry" parent="list" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Removes a single entry from the list `list` with key `key`.

This is equivalent to `list.Set( myList, myKey, nil )`.
	</description>
	<added>2025.05.15</added>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="list" type="string">List to remove an entry in.</arg>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key for the entry to remove.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
